candidates.requirement: A later fuzz invocation with valid audio input must be able to reach encoding after an earlier invocation requested the version.
candidates.target_route: A first input supplies -v; parse_option sets show_version. A second input supplies a valid WAVE file without -v. The entry resets getopt state, but init_options does not reset show_version, so do_it returns before encode_file.
candidates.failure_condition: After the first invocation, every later invocation in the same process takes the version return, leaving supported encoding unreachable.
candidates.alternative_paths: The complete init_options and free_options bodies do not clear show_version; the complete option parser only sets it. No input option restores the encoding route.
